notes.itemTitle: French health cover and travel insurance
notes.title: AON explains the cover
notes.body: INSEAD's Pre-MBA newsletter this morning names AON as your medical insurance provider and puts their session on 3 December, a week before this is due. They will cover partner cover too, and the hour is recorded. - It is on your calendar now; register from the link on the entry.

notes.title: Bain closes Sunday
notes.body: INSEAD's newsletter today carries a Bain EMEA summer-internship fellowship, with development workshops and interview coaching for anyone invited to interview. Applications close next Sunday, the 29th, and MBB is one of your three target groups. - The card has Accept and Reject on it, and the apply link is on your calendar.
